caption: The QA rule puts 114 of 120 code changes through review (95.0%), the reviews find 9+6+15 = 30 defects without running anything, and then the running product is tried: 8 of 10 users meet the 30-second target with mean 24.0 s, 2 do not, so the release is not accepted. The dashed arrow carries the three failed payment tests back to QA so the process step that let them in gets fixed.

spec.title: One UPI release through QA, verification, QC and validation
spec.aria: A downward chain from a QA rule of review before merge, to verification reviews finding 30 defects, to build 7, to QC where 37 of 40 payment tests pass, to validation where 8 of 10 users meet the 30-second target with mean 24.0 s, ending at not accepted; a dashed arrow runs from QC back to QA carrying 3 failures.
